description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff.

As an SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing educational programs for nursing staff, assessing competencies, and leading infection prevention and control initiatives. Your expertise will guide our team in maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards and best practices.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour. Join a facility committed to excellence and make a significant impact on our community's health and well-being.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection control
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently acquired center, playing a pivotal role in its growth and success.The ideal candidate will be a highly presentable and driven individual with a proven track record in healthcare marketing. This role requires a 'hustler' mentality, someone who is proactive in building relationships and driving census. Flexibility to work occasional weekends is essential to meet the demands of this fast-paced environment. We offer highly competitive compensation for the right candidate who can demonstrate exceptional results.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, ideally within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting.
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and build strong community relationships.
Professional demeanor and exceptional communication skills.
Strong initiative and a results-oriented approach.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Highly competitive compensation for the right candidate.
